verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Viam can be *driven by* an external AI agent via SDK/CLI (viam-docs-12, viam-docs-31/32), but that's the reverse relationship (agent-as-client) rather than Viam shipping a built-in AI assistant that helps the user inside the product. No evidence of an embedded assistant/copilot for configuration, debugging, or task delegation within the Viam app itself.
